comments:
Lost "master copy" of the text, from which (ID:4844) was copied.
The colophon at the end of the last instruction in instance (ID:4844) specifies that the text was written down at the occasion of a teaching by sKyo ston (ID:4052) to Chos kyi rgyal mtshan (ID:6458), without specifying the identity of the scribe. 
The post-colophon annotation identifying the scribe and person who requested the teaching as Chos kyi rgyal mtshan, and refers to the making of a subsequent copy "based on the master copy" (reading: phyag dpe dngos  las bris), which might have been owned by sKyo ston.
